title: RootMetadataProduction
description: Root trust metadata for the BANZA open financial protocol, produced by the offline root-key ceremony under a 2-of-3 custody threshold. Publishes ONLY public root keys, delegations, validity windows, ceremony evidence hashes, trust policy, and a 2-of-3 set of signatures. The real ceremony happens OFFLINE on the custodians' own computers; this artifact carries public material only. NO private keys, seeds, mnemonics or passphrases ever appear here or are ever transmitted. The 'scope' array constrains the root to root_metadata, delegation, rotation, revocation and trust_policy — the root does NOT sign payments, does NOT authorise operators, does NOT issue licences and does NOT move funds. The 'boundary' object records the permanent BANZA protocol/operator frontier by the positive: BANZA permanece protocolo financeiro aberto; operadores autorizados sao entidades separadas que implementam o protocolo. Any field asserting payment_authority:true, operator_authorisation_authority:true, moves_funds:true, settles_funds:true, holds_funds:true, licensed_by_banza:true, or production_certificates:true is FORBIDDEN and makes the ceremony INVALID (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_INVALID_REGULATORY_BOUNDARY / _INVALID_SCOPE). Status is computed by applying the ceremony rules stated in this contract. The rules are the definition; no implementation of them is.
_authority: Root Trust Ceremony (2-of-3 offline custody, docs/governance PKI trust model)
_boundary: Root trust for the BANZA open financial protocol. The root does NOT authorise payment services, does NOT create operators, does NOT issue licences, does NOT move/settle/hold funds, and does NOT replace operator regulatory authorisation. BANZA remains an open financial protocol; PSPs/banks/authorised operators are separate entities that implement it.

protocol.description: Protocol this root anchors. Always 'banza' — the open financial protocol.

environment.description: Trust environment. 'production' anchors the published protocol root of trust.

root_id.description: Stable identifier of this protocol root of trust (e.g. 'banza-root-2026').

threshold.description: Signature threshold. 2-of-3: any two custodians' signatures make the root metadata valid.

total_root_keys.description: Total independent root public keys. Three custodians (A, B, C), one key each.

keys.description: The three published root PUBLIC keys, one per custodian. Private keys NEVER appear. No device holds more than one root private key.

key_id.description: Unique id of this root public key (e.g. 'root-key-A').

custodian.description: Independent custodian holding the matching private key OFFLINE. Custodian A holds only root_key_A, B only root_key_B, C only root_key_C.

public_key.description: Root PUBLIC key material only (base64url, ed25519). Private keys are NEVER included.

fingerprint.description: Public fingerprint (hash) of the root public key.

delegations.description: Delegations from the root to purpose-specific signing keys (release/BRL/artifact/evidence). Delegated keys sign protocol artifacts — never payments, operators or funds. See root-delegation.production.schema.json.

valid_from.description: Start of this root metadata's validity window.

valid_until.description: End of this root metadata's validity window.

ceremony_id.description: Identifier of the offline root-key ceremony that produced this metadata.

ceremony_evidence_hash.description: Content hash over the public ceremony evidence record (see root-ceremony-evidence.production.schema.json). No secret material.

value.description: Digest over the canonical ceremony evidence bytes.

policy.description: Trust policy governing rotation, revocation and delegation under this root.

rotation_allowed.description: Whether root-key rotation is permitted under this policy.

revocation_allowed.description: Whether root-key revocation is permitted under this policy.

min_signatures.description: Minimum signatures required for any root action (2-of-3).

compromise_of_one_key_does_not_compromis.description: Property of the 2-of-3 model: compromise of a single key does not compromise the whole root.

loss_of_one_key_does_not_destroy_root.description: Property of the 2-of-3 model: loss of a single key does not destroy the root.

signatures.description: Custodian signatures over the canonical root metadata bytes. At least 2 of 3 required (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_THRESHOLD if fewer). Public signatures only.

key_id.description: Root key id that produced this signature.

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical metadata (base64url, ed25519). Public material.

scope.description: Allowed root actions, all of them root-metadata-scope: 'revocation' means delegated-key revocation recorded in root metadata — never the BANZA Revocation List (BRL), which is signed by the revocation-domain delegated key (INV-ROOT-005). The root signs ONLY these — never payments, operators, licences or funds.

boundary.description: Permanent protocol/operator boundary, asserted by the positive. Any of payment_service_authority:true, operator_authorisation_authority:true, moves_funds:true, settles_funds:true, holds_funds:true, issues_payment_licence:true, creates_operator:true is FORBIDDEN and makes the ceremony INVALID.

payment_service_authority.description: The root does NOT authorise payment services.

operator_authorisation_authority.description: The root does NOT authorise operators.

moves_funds.description: The root does NOT move funds.

settles_funds.description: The root does NOT settle funds.

holds_funds.description: The root does NOT hold funds.

issues_payment_licence.description: The root does NOT issue payment licences.

creates_operator.description: The root does NOT create operators.

requires_operator_regulatory_authorisati.description: Operadores autorizados sao entidades separadas que implementam o protocolo; usar para servicos reais exige a autorizacao regulatoria do operador.

_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
